items.title: How query count scales with the number of orders, N+1 vs. joined
items.description: This reproduces L3's exact measurement: the naive N+1 pattern issues one query for the order list plus one more per order, while the joined version always issues exactly 1. Drag the order count up toward the Scenario's actual 50,000 to see the same gap this unit's Scenario hit.
items.compute: const naiveQueries = params.orderCount + 1; const joinedQueries = 1; return { naiveQueries, joinedQueries };
